hooks.command: for py in /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/python3 /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/python3; do [ -x "$py" ] && "$py" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 15))' && exec "$py" "$HOME/.codex/hooks/git_guard.py"; done; echo 'git_guard.py: Python 3.15+ not found in /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin or /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin; run provision.sh or brew install python@3.15' >&2; exit 2
